finding.comment: The workflow reference must stay pinned to an immutable commit SHA; a mutable branch reference would let upstream pushes silently change the code that runs with DEPLOY_KEY access. This supply-chain pin must not be loosened.

files.patch:
--- a/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@
 jobs:
   ship:
-    uses: acme-platform/deploy-kit/.github/workflows/ship.yml@8f14e45fceea167a5a36dedd4bea2543aa76d1f4
+    uses: acme-platform/deploy-kit/.github/workflows/ship.yml@9c2b8d51f0e4a7c6d3b1a09f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0
     with:
       env: production
     secrets:
       DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_KEY }}

rationale: re-pin to a newer immutable SHA; the pinned-ref semantic is retained
